Role: Scientist, Senior / Senior Data Scientist (Strategy Data Science)
Company: Infor
Company category: Producto Tech
Location: Ciudad de México
Work model: Hybrid
Application language: en
JD fidelity: full (40/100)
JD generation eligible: true

Technologies / capabilities: Python; SQL; Snowflake; Regression; Segmentation; A/B testing; Survival analysis; Propensity modeling; SaaS analytics; Customer analytics; GenAI-assisted analytics; Executive storytelling; Machine Learning; Growth analytics; Strategy analytics; Stakeholder management
Requirements: Significant experience with SaaS product or customer analytics, including adoption, retention, engagement or lifecycle analytics in B2B SaaS or enterprise software.; Demonstrated ability to independently own full analytical projects from problem framing and data preparation through analysis and insight communication with minimal technical supervision.; Strong SQL and Python skills for independent data exploration, transformation, analytical dataset construction and statistical modeling; comfort with Snowflake.; Proven stakeholder-facing communication and ability to connect methodology to business narratives and recommended actions.; Solid statistical grounding in regression, segmentation, A/B testing, survival analysis and propensity modeling, including clear articulation of methodological tradeoffs.; Full professional English proficiency and legal authorization to work permanently in Mexico.; Preferred experience includes Customer Success analytics, measurable decision influence, data visualization/storytelling and generative-AI-assisted data science workflows.
Responsibilities: Own data science workstreams end to end from scoping through analysis, insight synthesis and stakeholder communication.; Manage day-to-day relationships with business partners and develop exploratory insights, statistical models and causal frameworks as appropriate.; Frame business objectives into clear analytical questions and influence problem definition before solution development.; Develop clear executive-facing narratives and presentations linking analytical findings to business decisions and outcomes.; Collaborate with the data science team on data foundations, analytical practices, innovations and shared business knowledge.; Develop production-ready analytical scripts and collaborate with IT to deploy insights into operational workflows.; Support adoption, retention, expansion and growth decisions with rigorous, actionable analysis.

Source fit score: 89/100
Source fit summary: Buen rol senior de producto/estrategia analítica para ampliar experiencia fuera de banca sin perder enfoque de negocio.
Source strengths: Senior individual contributor con ownership de workstreams analíticos end-to-end.; Trabaja con adopción, retención, expansión y crecimiento, traduciendo problemas estratégicos en análisis rigurosos.; Buen ajuste con Python, SQL, modelos de negocio, comunicación ejecutiva y liderazgo técnico sin gestión formal.
Source gaps: No se observa foco explícito en banca, riesgo, fraude o GenAI.; La información pública recuperada no muestra rango salarial ni stack completo.
